title: The Torsion of Automorphisms of Nilpotent Spaces
summary: We reprise a $K_1$-valued refinement of Whitehead torsion originally studied by Gersten. We use this Gersten torsion to show that for nilpotent spaces with infinite fundamental group, any self-equivalence which acts as the identity on the fundamental group has vanishing Whitehead torsion. We find two applications of our vanishing result. First, we provide many examples of spaces with infinitely many simple structures.
